subject: Honest wins: 30s customer anecdotes for Q4 sales one‑pagers
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Honest wins: 30s customer anecdotes for Q4 sales one‑pagers

Team —

Q4 sales push: I want a short bank of very human, 20–30 second customer anecdotes (think 2–3 sentences each) we can drop into one‑pagers and slide footers. Goal is to have 8–10 vetted quotes with permission by EOD next week.

Requirements:
- 20–30s anecdote (concise, outcome/impact oriented)
- Explicit permission to publish (we'll use the release form)
- Preferred metric if available (e.g., "reduced inference cost by 45%")

Marissa — can you own the Olive IT outreach? Grace — can you slot these into the one‑pager template once approved? Ben — please surface any existing customer soundbites you have from CS notes.

I attached the one‑pager template and a release form. Quick turnaround appreciated — these are going into the Q4 sales pack.

Thanks,
Logan
Head of Sales Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q4-onepager-template.pptx, customer-quote-release-form.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 09 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -0800

> Team —
> 
> Q4 sales push: I want a short bank of very human, 20–30 second customer anecdotes...

I'll take Olive IT. I'll use the short form approach: quick context line + impact line + optional stat. I'll ping Jenny today and include the release form.

Ben — if you can drop any raw quotes from CS in this thread (even one‑liners) I'll pare them down. Grace — can you confirm the template supports a single‑sentence attribution (company + role)?

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions PM, Sales Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Jenny Alvarez <jenny@oliveit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Nov 2028 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — can we share a 1–2 sentence quote from Olive IT in our Q4 materials?

Hi Jenny —

Hope you're well. Quick ask on behalf of our sales team: we're putting together short customer one‑pagers for Q4 and wondered if Olive IT would be willing to share a 1–2 sentence anecdote about the impact Redwood has had for you (example: "With Redwood we cut inference latency for our chat feature by ~40% and reduced per‑token spend by 30% — our devs shipped faster and support volume dropped"). We won't use anything beyond what you approve.

If that works, I've attached a simple release form (two lines) — feel free to edit. If easier, just reply to this email with the quote and permission line (e.g., "OK to use with attribution: Olive IT, Jane Alvarez, CTO").

Thanks so much — we value the partnership and want to showcase real outcomes.

Best,
Logan Wright
Head of Sales Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: customer-quote-release-form.pdf

From: Jenny Alvarez <jenny@oliveit.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Nov 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can we share a 1–2 sentence quote from Olive IT in our Q4 materials?

Logan —

Happy to help. Here's a short quote and permission:

"Redwood’s dedicated inference sped up our batch jobs and cut per‑token cost by ~35%. That allowed us to increase model coverage without blowing the budget."

OK to use with attribution: Olive IT, Jenny Alvarez, VP Product.

If you want a slightly edited, shorter version for a slide I can sign off on it — happy to review the final snippet.

Regards,

Quote (as received):
"Redwood’s dedicated inference sped up our batch jobs and cut per‑token cost by ~35%. That allowed us to increase model coverage without blowing the budget." — Olive IT, Jenny Alvarez, VP Product
